dyeutils.config.title: DyeUtils
dyeutils.config.group.party.desc: The list the invite hotkey sends to, the people you group with often, and what happens once Bacte is down.
dyeutils.config.partyMembers.edit.desc:
Add and remove the players to invite.

You can also use /dyeutils playerlist add <ign> and /dyeutils playerlist remove <ign>.
dyeutils.config.favourites.edit.desc:
The players you group with often, kept between sessions and separate from the party list.

Star someone on the party list to add them, or use /dyeutils favourites add <ign>.
dyeutils.roster.addHint: Type a username that is not on the list already.
dyeutils.partyList.title: Party List
dyeutils.partyList.searchHint: Search, or type a name to add
dyeutils.partyList.empty: No players yet. Use + Add Player below.
dyeutils.partyList.starHint: Finish typing a valid username to star it.
dyeutils.favourites.title: Favourites
dyeutils.favourites.searchHint: Search, or type a name to add
dyeutils.favourites.empty: No favourites yet. Star a name on the party list.
dyeutils.config.group.hotkeys.desc: These are ordinary Minecraft key binds, so they also show up under Options → Controls → Key Binds and may be bound to any key or mouse button.
dyeutils.config.hotkey.invite.desc: Invites every IGN on the list. Hypixel only accepts 5 invites per command, so longer lists are sent as several commands half a second apart.
dyeutils.config.group.bacte.desc: Bacte is the Rift Colosseum boss that drops the Celadon Dye.
dyeutils.config.bacteSkin.desc:
Renders Bacte as the Celadon Dye he drops instead of a slime, for all five phases of the fight.

Globowls and every other slime are left alone.
dyeutils.config.autoDisband.desc:
Runs /p disband when Hypixel announces Bacte is down, so the next group can be invited straight away.

Only Hypixel's own announcement counts. Someone typing it in chat does nothing.
dyeutils.config.inviteCommandPrefix.desc:
The command the IGNs are appended to. Hypixel documents /p invite <a> <b> <c> for inviting several players at once.

Change this to "/p " if you prefer the shorthand.
dyeutils.config.hideCommandsFromChat.des: When off, the commands DyeUtils sends are added to your chat history so you can recall them with the up arrow.
dyeutils.message.emptyList: Your party list is empty. Add some IGNs with /dyeutils first.
dyeutils.message.invitesPending: Hypixel is holding the rest until people join. %s left to invite.
dyeutils.message.disbanding: Bacte is down. Disbanding the party.
dyeutils.message.alreadyOnList: %s is already on the party list.
dyeutils.message.notOnList: %s is not on the party list.
dyeutils.message.invalidIgn: "%s" is not a valid username (3-16 letters, numbers or underscores).
dyeutils.message.notFavourite: %s is not one of your favourites.
